description: DGO Correspondence Mailer: create the DGOMailLog, DGOMailDirectory, DGOMailTemplates, DGOMailOperators, DGOMailSessions, DGOMailCampaigns, DGOMailReports, DGOMailFiles lists and library and their columns. Idempotent; validationOnly:true reports the plan and writes nothing.

lists.title: DGOMailLog
lists.description: DGO Correspondence Mailer - one row per message. Title is the messageId. Private to the flow owner.

fields.name: ToAddresses
fields.xml: <Field Type="Note" Name="ToAddresses" StaticName="ToAddresses" DisplayName="ToAddresses" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" UnlimitedLengthInDocumentLibrary="TRUE" />

fields.name: AttachmentNames
fields.xml: <Field Type="Note" Name="AttachmentNames" StaticName="AttachmentNames" DisplayName="AttachmentNames" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" UnlimitedLengthInDocumentLibrary="TRUE" />

fields.name: ErrorMessage
fields.xml: <Field Type="Note" Name="ErrorMessage" StaticName="ErrorMessage" DisplayName="ErrorMessage" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" UnlimitedLengthInDocumentLibrary="TRUE" />

lists.title: DGOMailDirectory
lists.description: DGO Correspondence Mailer - addressee directory. Title is the institution key.

fields.name: CcEmails
fields.xml: <Field Type="Note" Name="CcEmails" StaticName="CcEmails" DisplayName="CcEmails" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" UnlimitedLengthInDocumentLibrary="TRUE" />

fields.name: Notes
fields.xml: <Field Type="Note" Name="Notes" StaticName="Notes" DisplayName="Notes" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" UnlimitedLengthInDocumentLibrary="TRUE" />

lists.title: DGOMailTemplates
lists.description: DGO Correspondence Mailer - letter templates. Title is the template key. Private to the flow owner.

fields.name: BodyHtml
fields.xml: <Field Type="Note" Name="BodyHtml" StaticName="BodyHtml" DisplayName="BodyHtml" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" UnlimitedLengthInDocumentLibrary="TRUE" />

fields.name: Description
fields.xml: <Field Type="Note" Name="Description" StaticName="Description" DisplayName="Description" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" UnlimitedLengthInDocumentLibrary="TRUE" />

lists.title: DGOMailOperators
lists.description: DGO Correspondence Mailer - who may sign in. Title is the operator's email address, lower case. Role: operator or admin. Private to the flow owner.

lists.title: DGOMailSessions
lists.description: DGO Correspondence Mailer - sign-in codes and sessions. Private to the flow owner. Title is the challenge id.

fields.name: Email
fields.xml: <Field Type="Text" Name="Email" StaticName="Email" DisplayName="Email" MaxLength="255" Indexed="TRUE" />

fields.name: Token
fields.xml: <Field Type="Text" Name="Token" StaticName="Token" DisplayName="Token" MaxLength="255" Indexed="TRUE" />

fields.name: Status
fields.xml: <Field Type="Text" Name="Status" StaticName="Status" DisplayName="Status" MaxLength="255" Indexed="TRUE" />

lists.title: DGOMailCampaigns
lists.description: DGO Correspondence Mailer - every mailing and its per-recipient results, shared across devices. Title is the mailing id. Private to the flow owner.

fields.name: Data
fields.xml: <Field Type="Note" Name="Data" StaticName="Data" DisplayName="Data" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" UnlimitedLengthInDocumentLibrary="TRUE" />

lists.title: DGOMailReports
lists.description: DGO Correspondence Mailer - the report of every operation (the Activity page), shared across devices. Title is the report id.

fields.name: Data
fields.xml: <Field Type="Note" Name="Data" StaticName="Data" DisplayName="Data" NumLines="6" RichText="FALSE" UnlimitedLengthInDocumentLibrary="TRUE" />

lists.title: DGOMailFiles
lists.description: DGO Correspondence Mailer - attached letters and enclosures, shared across devices. File name: <id>__<original name>.

error.message: This flow has not been configured: set operatorKey in Compose_Config (16+ characters, not starting with "__").

@if(outputs('Compose_Caller')?['lookupFailed'], 'The sign-in could not be checked just now (SharePoint did not answer). Nothing was done; try again in a moment.', 'Sign in first: the session is missing, has expired, was signed out, or its operator is no longer active.')
healthCheck must be called with validationOnly:true.

parameters.parameters/uri: @concat('_api/web/lists?$select=Title&$filter=', encodeUriComponent(concat('Title eq ''', outputs('Compose_Config')?['logList'], '''', ' or ', 'Title eq ''', outputs('Compose_Config')?['directoryList'], '''', ' or ', 'Title eq ''', outputs('Compose_Config')?['templatesList'], '''', ' or ', 'Title eq ''', outputs('Compose_Config')?['operatorsList'], '''', ' or ', 'Title eq ''', outputs('Compose_Config')?['sessionsList'], '''')))

@concat('_api/web/lists/GetByTitle(''', items('Apply_to_each_List')?['title'], ''')/fields?$select=InternalName,Indexed&$filter=', encodeUriComponent('InternalName eq ''Title'' or InternalName eq ''Created'''))

error.message: @concat('The flow failed before it could answer. Run id: ', workflow()?['run']?['name'])
